Bolla, was an American actor who had a pornographic acting career during what is considered to be the "golden age" period of the porn film industry during the mid-1970s to the early/mid-1980s.
As Bolla, he appeared in well over 100 pornographic films, most famously Debbie Does Dallas (1978).
